title: 并列句式的衔接
goal: 利用句式和信息层级判断并列句之间的衔接。

points.label: 利用并列形式识别同层级信息
核对并列句的话题与信息层级

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）课表

body.p: 并列句讲同一话题下同一层级的信息，语法形式通常一致。只看句式不够，话题和层级也要和上下文相符。

body.box: Label each box. Place it on the correct shelf.

body.p: 两句都是祈使句，分别提出整理物品的建议。

cards.title: 并列形式
rows: Check the address. Seal the envelope.
Choose a topic. Gather the materials.
Walking improves balance. Swimming exercises the whole body.
Sorting saves space. Labeling saves time.
The first item is a map. The second is a compass.
One team measured the wall; the other, the floor.

cards.title: 话题与层级
rows: Use a pencil. Keep a ruler nearby.
The route is short. It is also well lit.
The room has useful equipment. For example, it has a printer.
设备与打印机为总分关系。
Pack the clothes. Plant a tree.

body.box:
To prepare a display, first choose the objects. ____ Finally, place the labels beside them.
1. Arrange the objects on a table.
2. Explain that objects are useful.
3. Plant the flowers beside the path.
4. A label is one kind of sign.

body.p: 第一项与前后句都是布置展览的步骤，也都用祈使句。第三项同为祈使句，但话题不同。

groups.text: To store the photographs, sort them by date. ____ Finally, write the year on each box.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: Put each group in a separate box.
Photographs can record family events.
Sorting by date takes a long time.
Put the photographs in a frame.
items.why: 第一项的 Put 与 sort、write 一样是祈使句，都是存放照片的步骤；separate box 又引出后句的 each box。第四项也是祈使句，但装进相框不是存放步骤。

groups.text: One group washed the brushes; ____. Both groups cleaned their equipment before leaving.

items.stem: Which phrase best fills the gap?
options: the brushes remained wet
the paint had already dried
the other, the paint trays
the equipment was quite clean
items.why: 第三项 the other, the paint trays 省略了 washed，与前一分句并列，后句的 Both groups 指这两组。

groups.text: The club chose the hall because it is spacious. ____ Both features help when many members attend.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: For example, it seats fifty people.
It is also close to the station.
The club chose a smaller room instead.
Many members attend each week.
items.why: 离车站近与空间宽敞都是选这个礼堂的理由，后句的 Both features 指这两项。第一项只是宽敞的例子，不是第二项特点。

groups.text: Collect leaves from different trees. ____ Compare their shapes after both sets have dried.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: Leaves dry faster in a warm room.
Collect rainwater in a clean jar.
Press each leaf flat between two heavy books.
Collect seeds from different trees.
items.why: 采集种子与采集树叶是并列的两项收集工作，后句的 both sets 指这两组。第二项句式相同，但雨水没有形状可比。

groups.text: The first group listed the birds; ____. The notes from both groups were added to the survey.

items.stem: Which phrase best fills the gap?
options: the other, the insects
the birds flew away
the survey ended last week
the notes described one group
items.why: 第一项省略了 listed，与第一组记录鸟类的工作并列，后句的 both groups 指这两组。

groups.text: Plan a route before the walk. ____ Both steps help the group stay together.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: Walks can be enjoyable for a group.
A route may pass through a park.
Agree on a meeting point as well.
Check the weather forecast too.
items.why: 约定集合点与规划路线是同层级的两项准备，都能让队伍不走散，即第三项。第四项也是准备，但与 stay together 无关。

groups.text:
A neighborhood group planned a book exchange. To make the event easy to use, the members divided the preparation into separate tasks. First, collect books in good condition. ____ Then put each category on a different table. Clear labels will help visitors find books quickly.

The first team arranged the tables; ____. The two teams finished their work before the doors opened. The group selected the hall because it was close to a bus stop. ____ Both features made it practical for the exchange.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the first gap?
options: Poor books are not accepted.
Sort the books into categories.
Arrange the tables near the doors.
Clear labels help visitors find books.
items.why: 第二项的 Sort 与 collect、put 一样是祈使句，categories 又引出后句的 each category。第三项也是祈使句，但后句的 each category 在前文找不到对应。

items.stem: Which phrase best fills the second gap?
options: the doors opened at ten
the tables stood near the doors
the group selected the hall
the second, the book labels
items.why: 第四项省略了 arranged，与第一组的工作并列，后句的 The two teams 指这两组。

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the third gap?
options: It also had room for several tables.
For example, one table held novels.
The bus stop was closed that morning.
Visitors could find books quickly.
items.why: 空间够大与离车站近都是选这个礼堂的理由，后句的 Both features 指这两项，即第一项。

groups.text:
A class prepared a guide for visitors to a small orchard. The pupils first observed the trees and recorded their findings. One group counted the apple trees; ____. The groups combined their counts in a single table.

The guide suggested ways to protect the orchard. Stay on marked paths. ____ Both actions reduce damage to the plants. The pupils also described two reasons for visiting: the orchard had a range of trees, and ____. These features gave visitors opportunities to learn and observe.

items.stem: Which phrase best fills the first gap?
options: the trees stood near a path
the pupils recorded their findings
another, the pear and plum trees
the guide explained the counts
items.why: 第三项省略了 counted，与前一分句的计数并列，后句的 The groups combined their counts 指两组的计数。

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the second gap?
options: Marked paths lead through the orchard.
Leave the fruit on the trees.
Count the apple trees on the way.
Learn the names of the trees.
items.why: Leave 与 Stay 都是保护果园的建议，后句的 Both actions 指这两项，即第二项。第三项也是祈使句，但与保护果园无关。

items.stem: Which phrase best fills the third gap?
options: the pupils counted the trees
visitors should stay on marked paths
the guide had a table of counts
its paths had signs about the trees
items.why: 树的种类多、路边有讲解树木的牌子，都是参观的理由，后句的 These features 指这两项，即第四项。第二项是建议，不是理由。
